L265: ## About Our Hospital
L266: 
L267: Metropolitan Veterinary Hospital will always combine teamwork, training, and technology to create your pet's happiest, healthiest life.
L268: 
L269: 【4†About Us】
L270: ## Client Reviews & Testimonials
L271: 
L272: My husband and I took our young kitty here for a cardiologist appointment and every staff member I spoke to was insanely kind and friendly. I felt very comfortable here even though we aren't from around the area. Thankful that lil Hashbrown is just fine and thankful for their attentive care for our pet.
L273: 
L274: Megan T.
L275: We have taken two of our dogs here. Their doctors are very thorough and knowledgeable. The hospital staff are very caring. This last visit we saw Dr. Brie Anne Mauser. She walked through our options in detail. Your pets will receive good care here.
L276: 
L277: Cindy D.
L278: We took our cat here when he was expeiencing pain from a soft tissue injury in his hip. Dr. Page and all the staff were very professional and friendly. The doctor prescribed some anti inflammatory meds and based on her examination, she recommended not spending the extra money on X Rays because our cat exhibited no signs of a fracture. Very honest people here who care about pets and their owners. Highly recommended.
L279: 
L280: Daniel C.
